products.label: A
products.reason: It is the same kind of authentication offering as the prior multifactor authentication and one-time password services, aimed at the same security customers.

products.label: B
products.reason: It builds on the firm’s existing transaction-signing and signature-token products, but extends them from transactions to document signing.

products.label: C
products.reason: It sits in the same identity and access security space as the prior identity security platform and server, though in a more general framework form.

products.label: D
products.reason: Secure email delivery is a different product category and customer use case than the firm’s prior focus on authentication, tokens, and signing.

products.label: E
products.reason: A QR-code signature token is the same product family as the earlier Bluetooth and USB signature tokens, just using a different interface.

products.label: F
products.reason: SWIFT compliance security is a specialized banking and payments compliance offering that goes beyond the identity and signing products previously shown.
